description: Feature inventory for the academic-writer plugin. A checklist for future audits: each top-level feature lists its subfeatures, the source of truth, runtime status, and known issues. status: ok | partial | broken | missing. Regenerate/extend this file whenever features are added or removed.

subfeatures.name: Init wizard (Preflight, Integrations, Profile incl. author_key, Gemini Onboarding, Style Analysis, Sources) with --quick mode
setup skill — now a thin non-invocable wrapper pointing to /academic-writer:init --quick
subfeatures.issue: Duplication resolved by folding setup's phases into init's --quick mode; setup itself carries no phase logic and is user-invocable: false

subfeatures.name: extract-style-metrics.py computational metrics
subfeatures.issue: src/scripts/extract-style-metrics.py now exists and emits computationalMetrics + frequentTerms; surfaced into profile.md's Style Fingerprint section by init

subfeatures.name: Fetch Hebrew linguistic baseline from CandleKeep
subfeatures.issue: Now looked up by exact title ("Hebrew Linguistic Reference") via `ck items list --json | jq`, with a loud warning + manual-search instruction if the lookup fails or is ambiguous, and the old hardcoded id kept only as a documented, never-silent last-resort fallback

subfeatures.name: Share one author's voice across projects
subfeatures.issue: Sync is now keyed by the stable author_key field in .academic-helper/profile.md (derived from the researcher's name during init, confirmed via AskUserQuestion); voice-sync.sh fails loudly (exit 1, no silent <unknown> fallback) if author_key is missing. Still CandleKeep-only for cross-project persistence, which is expected given the no-$HOME rule

subfeatures.name: Mode B: structured outline + word/paragraph sizing
subfeatures.issue: Sections exceeding thresholds.json writerUnit.maxWords are now decomposed into a units[] array of writer-unit subsections sized within writerUnit.minWords-maxWords (target writerUnit.targetWords), adjacent tiny units merged; decomposition is prompt-enforced (markdown agent instructions), not code-enforced

subfeatures.name: Explicit premise→support→thesis-link logical model
subfeatures.issue: Every section and writer unit now carries an argument-graph node (id, claim, evidence[], depends_on[], thesis_link, argument_role nested as a field); validated up front by write/SKILL.md Step 5.5 (orphan/cycle/empty-evidence/topological-order checks) before section-writers are spawned, not just post-hoc in self-review

subfeatures.name: Mode C: ownership-only from user draft
One section-writer subagent per writer unit (parallel)
Gemini gemini_write_section primary path (Skills 1-7)
subfeatures.issue: section_brief contract fixed: WriteSectionInput now accepts either the structured object (title/description/argument_role/paragraph_count/is_intro/is_conclusion/intro_or_conclusion_rules/paragraph_word_ceiling) documented in section-writer.md or a legacy plain string; self_review_scores keys renamed to style_fingerprint/academic_language to match the agent's documented return shape. Verified by tests/e2e/write-section-schema-contract.mjs (8/8 assertions pass).

subfeatures.name: Claude in-context 8-skill fallback pipeline
subfeatures.issue: Duplicates all Skills 1-7; heavy maintenance surface

subfeatures.name: Skill 2: style fingerprint compliance (10-dim rubric)
subfeatures.issue: extract-style-metrics.py now produces computationalMetrics.*; rubric also now reads frequentTerms for personal-lexicon preference

subfeatures.name: Skill 4: linking-word variety
subfeatures.issue: Now also draws on the positive academic-terminology-{en,he}.md references (hedging verbs, argumentation connectives, citation-introduction verbs, transitions)

subfeatures.name: Skill 6 Tier 1: detect-ai-typography.py (em-dash/quote/RTL punctuation)
subfeatures.issue: src/scripts/detect-ai-typography.py now exists and is invoked by section-writer.md Step B / Skill 6 Tier 1

subfeatures.name: Cross-section and unit-to-unit coherence/flow review
subfeatures.issue: synthesizer.md now checks Argument Graph Fidelity — that delivered prose actually advances each unit/section's declared claim, that depends_on dependencies are built upon in the text (not just declared in the outline), and that the thesis_link chain genuinely reaches the thesis in the final prose; also checks subsection-to-subsection (unit-to-unit) transitions within a section, not only section-to-section

subfeatures.name: Hebrew pattern list A-K (openers, meta-summary, dramatic, citation format)
Positive discipline-standard terminology lexicon (EN+HE)
subfeatures.issue: Added src/skills/write/references/academic-terminology-{english,hebrew}.md (~90 entries each: hedging verbs, argumentation connectives, citation-introduction verbs, section transitions, colloquial→academic substitution tables). Wired into section-writer.md, the Gemini write-section prompt/bundle (positiveTerminology), review/SKILL.md's Academic Conventions dimension, and proofread's idea-flag triggers.

subfeatures.name: inline-parenthetical / chicago / mla / apa
subfeatures.issue: Gemini prompt inline-parenthetical example uses (Author Year, page), contradicting Hebrew (name, עמ' N) no-year rule

subfeatures.name: gemini_write_section
subfeatures.issue: Contract fixed to match section-writer.md — see section-writing.gemini-write for detail

subfeatures.name: Cached voice+fingerprint+words+antiAi+rubric+positiveTerminology bundle
subfeatures.issue: bundle.ts now also loads the language-appropriate academic-terminology-*.md via loadPositiveTerminology(), mirroring the existing loadAntiAi() pattern, and renders it under a POSITIVE ACADEMIC TERMINOLOGY section

subfeatures.name: pytest structural + contract + voice tests
subfeatures.issue: No test asserts referenced scripts exist; missing scripts pass CI
